basis: Edwin Chen’s first-person account embedded in discussion of model incentives.
reported_outcomes: Reports spending 30 minutes across 30 email versions on a message he later judged unimportant.
proposed_outcomes: Use as failure evidence for deciding when enough is enough.
limits: One recollection; no measured counterfactual time or proof of a company’s objective function. Asking AI to tell the user to stop also delegates the value judgment.
review_note: Counterexample supporting stopping, not a new prompt recommendation.
practitioner: The person defines sufficient quality and importance; do not outsource the stopping rule to a reassuring model.
coverage: Read metadata/intro and complete relevant exchanges with surrounding discussion at the locators below; not the full episode.
